name: RapidAPI
tagline: RapidAPI is a large API marketplace where developers discover, test, and subscribe to thousands of APIs from a single platform with unified authentication and billing. Developers use it to find third-party APIs for weather, payments, translation, sports data, and hundreds of other categories without managing separate accounts and keys for each provider. API publishers list their products on RapidAPI to reach developers who are already searching for solutions rather than building distribution from scratch.
